description: Bootstrap collapse.js v3.2.0 defines a Collapse class for managing collapsible UI components, including methods for showing, hiding, toggling, and handling transition effects. It also sets up jQuery plugin integration and data-API event handling.

classes.name: Collapse
classes.description: Class managing the collapse behavior of UI elements, including show, hide, toggle, and transition handling.

methods.name: dimension
methods.description: Returns the dimension ('width' or 'height') used for collapsing based on element's classes.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Expands the collapsible element with transition effects.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Collapses the element with transition effects.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles between show and hide states.
